description: Launch a clinical demonstration application in OpenICE. On the left side of the OpenICE Supervisor main screen, you will see a grid of application icons representing various clinical demonstration apps. Click on the 'Vital Signs' application icon (or 'Xray Viewer' or 'Patient ID' app if available) to launch it. The application will open and begin displaying data from any connected device adapters. After observing the application, click the 'Exit App' button in the bottom left corner to return to the Supervisor home screen.
